title: The Fourth, 2011
logline: White fireworks. The last Fourth before the motel. Wood on the steps with the dog in his lap, carried down. The chair, Maria's now, with the baby.

panels.composition: The dock, fireworks white on blue. GULLY pouring. MARIA in the lawn chair with the baby. WOOD on the steps, BARNABY in his lap, twelve, not walking down tonight.

characters.pose: in the chair with the baby
